DONE

Not built or compiled: I had no build tools or network access, so the code is checked by reading only.

- **Gradle wrapper missing:** writing `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties` was refused as a sensitive file, so I left it out. Also missing are the wrapper jar and `gradlew` scripts. Android Studio or `gradle wrapper` will generate them.
- **AuthRepository is a placeholder:** `ShelfTapApplication.kt` has a stub whose `accessToken()` throws. Replace it with your existing implementation before running.
- **Assumptions I made:**
  - All IDs are strings.
  - Renewal failures are detected by the `RENEWAL_NOT_ALLOWED` text in the error body, since the exact error format wasn't given.
  - Offline fallback applies only to network failures (`IOException`); HTTP errors show an error state.
  - Overdue loans show an "Overdue" badge instead of a days-left count.
  - Turning history off clears nothing locally; it just reloads the server's empty list.
- **Dependency versions:** AGP 8.7.3, Kotlin 2.0.21, Compose BOM 2024.10.01, plus OkHttp, kotlinx-serialization and Coil. These are from memory and may need bumping.

Layout: `settings.gradle.kts`, root and `app/build.gradle.kts`, `gradle.properties`, manifest, resources, and 17 Kotlin files under `app/src/main/java/vn/shelftap/app/`.
